description:
From the fz-kdt.144 cold review (2026-09-02, d2a5f3510). drive_test.rs
dispatch_call_edges (~:9156) yields only BackendTail::DirectCall { target:
CallEdge::Dispatch(..) } plans, so compiler2_dispatch_blind_escape_census_
is_the_known_population, compiler2_dispatch_seats_the_covering_arm_where_
one_covers and ARM_ORDER_CENSUS reason over a STRICT SUBSET of the dispatch
surface: an executable's entry_dispatch (clause dispatch) and every
construction wrapper's `selection` plan (member selection) are never
inspected. 00277_enum_tier0_fixture IS in ARM_ORDER_CENSUS and the census
reports nothing for it while its wrapper w2 seats list(int) ahead of
list(int | :tail) -- the escape the dynamic tripwire found on its first
pass (12 values, [1, :tail] and its growth, running the [integer] body).
FIX: one walk over every plan the artifact carries (call-edge dispatch,
entry_dispatch, wrapper selection), each arm paired with the observable
surface its body was compiled for, feeding the same seated_arm_surfaces /
covers / blind_escapes readers; the doc sentence "Every position in the
census where the arm seated first does not name what the arm seated second
holds" becomes true. Expected: the census turns RED on 00277's wrapper
selection (the reproducer for the cure ticket), and the population must be
named per plan kind. Sequence: BEFORE the cure, so the cure is red-first.
title: The static blind-escape census walks only call-edge dispatches: entry_dispatch and construction-wrapper selection plans are outside every seating gate
